description: This file defines a Flutter widget named WinPulse that adds a scaling pulse animation to its child widget, used to highlight winning tiles in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. The widget manages an animation controller that scales the child widget slightly when enabled, providing visual feedback.

classes.name: WinPulse
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a subtle scaling pulse animation to its child when enabled, used to visually emphasize winning tiles.

classes.name: _WinPulseState
classes.description: The private state class for WinPulse, managing the animation controller and the animation logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and sets up the scaling animation. Starts the pulse if enabled.

methods.name: didUpdateWidget
methods.description: Handles updates to the widget, starting or stopping the pulse animation based on the enabled property.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controller when the widget is removed to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, applying ScaleTransition when enabled to animate the child widget.
